items.stem: A supplier offers 2/10 net 30. What is the approximate annualised cost of NOT taking the discount?

options.text: About 37% - the 2% saved over the 20 extra days annualises to a high implied rate
options.rationale: Correct: 2/98 over 20 days annualised is roughly 37%, usually worth taking if cash allows.

options.text: About 2% - the discount is only 2% so the cost is 2%
options.rationale: This ignores that the 2% is earned over only 20 days, not a full year.
This understates the annualised rate; the correct basis uses 2/98 over 20 days.

options.text: Zero - there is never a cost to paying later
options.rationale: Forgoing the discount has a real implied financing cost.

items.explanation: Correct: 2/98 over 20 days annualised is roughly 37%, usually worth taking if cash allows.

items.stem: Which TWO controls most directly reduce the risk of duplicate supplier payments? (Select TWO.)

options.text: System blocking of invoices with a matching supplier, amount and invoice number
options.rationale: Correct: duplicate detection on key fields stops repeat payments.

options.text: Three-way match of PO, goods receipt and invoice before payment
options.rationale: Correct: matching prevents paying for goods not ordered or received, including re-keyed duplicates.

options.text: Paying every invoice immediately on receipt
options.rationale: Speed without matching increases duplicate and fraud risk.

options.text: Letting one person raise, approve and pay invoices
options.rationale: Lack of segregation enables both error and fraud.

items.explanation: Correct: duplicate detection on key fields stops repeat payments.

items.stem: Extending supplier payment terms from 30 to 60 days will, all else equal, most directly:

options.text: Increase days payable outstanding and free up working capital short term
options.rationale: Correct: paying later raises DPO and retains cash, though it may strain suppliers.
Payment terms affect payables and cash, not revenue directly.
Timing of payment does not change the cost of goods purchased.

options.text: Eliminate the need for cash-flow forecasting
options.rationale: Forecasting remains essential regardless of terms.
